# 2 Baruch Chapter 46 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Third Fast and Dialogue

---

**46:1** And-it-came-to-pass, when-Baruch had-spoken these-words to-all-the-people, that he-said-to-them: "After-a-little-while I-shall-depart from-you; and-after that-which-has-happened, I-shall-be-taken-away from-this-place."

**46:2** "For-I-know that-the-land-of-Israel will-be-desolate; and-Zion will-be-left desolate; and-the-holy-vessels will-be-taken away; and-the-people will-be-scattered."

**46:3** "But-do-not grieve on-account-of these-things, for-a-time-is-coming when all-that-has-been-taken-away will-be-returned, and-the-ruins will-be-rebuilt, and-the-scattered will-be-gathered-together."

**46:4** "For-I-know that they-will-serve their-enemies in-captivity, and-that-their-children will-learn the-ways-of-the-nations; but do-not grieve, for-the-law will-remain with-you."

**46:5** "For-I-depart to-my-fathers, as Moses went, who-was-the-great-messenger, and-who-left-behind him Aaron and-Joshua. I-am-leaving with-you Gedaliah the-son-of-Ahikam."

**46:6** "Give-ear to-him, and-he-will-be-a-guide-to-you; and-do-not forget the-law, but-instruct those-who-are-wise in-it, that-they-may-not depart from-it."

**46:7** And-it-came-to-pass, when-Baruch had-finished these-words to-all-the-people, that he-rose-up from-among-them, and-he-departed to-the-oak-tree that-was-at-Mamre.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Hyphenated compounds preserve construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text.*
